about.title: Volleyball is a game of moments. / I photograph the moments.
about.body1: I photograph volleyball in Bremen and northern Germany — match days, season-long coverage, portraits. My focus is on cinematic single moments that make the game readable as a visual narrative.
about.body2: If you'd like a court, a team, or a federation covered photographically, drop me a line. I plan seasons ahead and like recurring work.
about.pullQuote: A match is 100 frames. Three of them matter.
